newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Rebhold to raise 50 mln rand in listing.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Rebhold to raise 50 mln rand in listing.

text.p: South African liquor, food and freight forwarding company, Rebhold will raise 50 million rand when it lists on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Wednesday, it said in a statement.
"The capital raised will be used to eliminate debt and stock the war-chest for future acquisitions," Jacques Kempen, Rebhold chief executive officer said on Monday.
The company, which was originally formed out of the merger of liquor groups Picardi and Rebel, will have have an initial market capitalisation of 264 million rand.
Earnings are forecast to grow by at least 20 percent to 20.5 cents a share in the year to end-June 1997 from 17.1 cents the year before. Rebhold intends to adopt a dividend policy of 3.3 times cover.
Kempen said the forecast was based on the planned development of synergies between operating divisions.
"We are developing synergies between liquor and food where we transport basic foodstuffs to the lesiure, hospitality and industrial catering industries on a daily basis."
The company will be listed through the private placement of 23 million shares at 220 cents per share.
